$description: Halderworks Instrument. Generated by tools/export.py from tokens.json. Colour tokens carry one $value per theme under $extensions.halderworks.themes; $value is the first theme.

ground.$description: The page or window background. Every screen starts here.

surface.$description: Cards, panels and table bodies: one step off the ground.

surface-hover.$description: The hover fill of a row, a menu item or a quiet button. 1.08:1 off surface in light, 1.04:1 in dark: a step the eye finds and the layout does not.

surface-active.$description: The pressed fill, and the skeleton fill while content loads. One step past hover.

surface-raised.$description: Things that float over content and can be dismissed: dialogs, popovers, menus. In light theme this is the same white as surface on purpose - what separates them there is the shadow. In dark theme it is a real lightness step, because a shadow on a dark ground is invisible.

surface-sunken.$description: Wells that recede: sidebars, code blocks, an input at rest.

border.$description: The 1px hairline: card and panel edges, table and cell borders, the tab baseline, chart axes and gridlines, the masthead rule, a framed quotation. Separates a container from its ground without being read as an edge.

border-strong.$description: Control outlines that must be seen: inputs, selects, textareas, checkboxes, switches, slider rails, secondary buttons, the selected segment of a segmented control, and a floating panel's edge. Held to WCAG 1.4.11's 3:1 as a control boundary: 3.01:1 at worst in both themes. The first two passes shipped it at 1.64:1 light and 1.92:1 dark on hw-surface.

text.$description: Primary text. 14.83:1 on ground, 15.78:1 on surface, 13.98:1 on surface-sunken.

text-secondary.$description: Supporting text, descriptions, metadata. 6.37:1 on ground.

text-muted.$description: Column heads, placeholders, timestamps. 4.88:1 on ground, the floor of this system.

text-disabled.$description: Text and icons in a disabled control. Held to the 3:1 non-text bar, not to AA, and solved per theme because one opacity cannot mean one thing in both: hw-text at 45% composites to 1.73:1 in light and 7.40:1 in dark.

ink.$description: The primary action fill: one filled button per screen, and the selected segment of a segmented control. Carries no hue so the accent stays scarce.

ink-hover.$description: Hover state of a primary action.

ink-active.$description: The pressed fill of a primary button. One step past hover in the same direction, so a press is distinguishable from a hover on the one control that commits an action.

ink-text.$description: Text and icons on an ink fill. 17.63:1 on ink.

accent.$description: The one brand hue. Links, selected state, live state, focus. 5.09:1 on ground.

accent-hover.$description: Hover state of an accent link or accent fill.

accent-quiet.$description: A flat accent tint for a selected row or an accent badge. Solved so hw-accent clears AA on it, which the first pass asserted but never checked.

accent-ring.$description: The focus ring, at 2px with a 2px offset. Held to the WCAG 2.2 non-text bar of 3:1 against the surface CLOSEST to it in lightness, not against the ground: solved against the ground alone it measured 2.56:1 on hw-surface-raised in dark theme.

success.$description: Passed, verified, settled: a badge, a validation summary, a positive delta against a baseline. Never a brand colour. 5.10:1 on ground.

success-quiet.$description: Fill behind success text in a badge or banner. Solved so hw-success clears AA on it, which the first pass asserted but never checked.

warning.$description: Retried, degraded, expiring: a badge, an inline alert, a banner on a partial load. 5.10:1 on ground. Dark amber rather than yellow because no yellow clears 4.5:1 on a light ground.

warning-quiet.$description: Fill behind warning text in a badge or banner. Solved so hw-warning clears AA on it, which the first pass asserted but never checked.

danger.$description: Failed, revoked, destructive: a badge, a field error border, a destructive menu item, a negative delta. 5.09:1 on ground.

danger-quiet.$description: Fill behind danger text in a badge or banner. Solved so hw-danger clears AA on it, which the first pass asserted but never checked.

chart-1.$description: First data series. Shares the accent hue so the primary series reads as the subject.

chart-2.$description: Second data series, in bars, lines, areas and their direct labels. Never a state.

chart-3.$description: Third data series, in bars, lines, areas and their direct labels. Never a state.

chart-4.$description: Fourth data series, in bars, lines, areas and their direct labels. Never a state.

chart-5.$description: Fifth data series, in bars, lines, areas and their direct labels. Never a state.

chart-6.$description: Sixth data series. Six is the limit; past that, group the tail.

scrim.$description: Behind a dialog only. Nothing else dims the page.

space-2.$description: The badge's vertical inset, and nothing else. At 4px a micro badge stands taller than the label beside it. The icon-to-label gap is --hw-icon-gap at 6px; this token claimed that job too and did not have it.

space-4.$description: Inside a badge or a chip; the gap between a label and its control.

space-8.$description: Between controls in a row; padding inside a dense table cell.

space-12.$description: Padding inside a button or input; the gap between list rows.

space-16.$description: Padding inside a card; the gap between cards.

space-24.$description: Between a heading and its content; padding in a dialog.

space-32.$description: Padding at a screen's edge; between sections of a form.

space-48.$description: Between major sections of a page.

space-64.$description: Above and below a page heading on a marketing surface.

space-96.$description: Between bands on a marketing surface. The largest step; nothing is bigger.

radius-sm.$description: Things inside other things: badges, checkboxes, swatches, the status dot.

radius-md.$description: Interactive controls: buttons, inputs, selects, menu items, tabs.

radius-lg.$description: Containers: cards, panels, dialogs, popovers, toasts.

radius-full.$description: Avatars and count pills only, where the shape itself carries the meaning.

shadow-overlay.$description: Popovers, menus and toasts in light theme. Dark theme carries elevation by surface lightness instead.

shadow-dialog.$description: Dialogs and sheets in light theme, the only element allowed a shadow this large, and a menu-bar panel in both themes (36-form-factors.md).

duration-instant.$description: A state change the user is already looking at: a checkbox tick, a switch knob, a segmented-control fill.

duration-fast.$description: The default for every transition: hover fills, focus rings, border colour, disclosure. 0.15s is the most-used duration across the reference set.

duration-base.$description: Something entering or leaving the layer stack: a popover, a menu, a toast.

duration-slow.$description: A dialog or a sheet, where the scrim and the panel move together and the user must follow both.

ease-out.$description: The default, for anything appearing or responding to a press: fast at the start, settled at the end.

ease-in.$description: Only for something leaving the screen, where the exit should not compete for attention.

ease-standard.$description: A value moving between two on-screen positions, such as a slider thumb or a progress fill.

bp-sm.$description: Phone to small tablet. Below it a screen is one column and the rail is a sheet.

bp-md.$description: The measured consensus edge: 23 of 44 captured sites declare a 768px min-width, more than any other value.

bp-lg.$description: Second most declared, on 18 of 44. The rail becomes permanent here.

bp-xl.$description: Declared on 12 of 44. The content column stops growing; the margins take the rest.

bp-2xl.$description: Only a wide table or a three-pane shell uses the extra width. Prose never does.

gutter-sm.$description: Page margin below hw-bp-md. Measured at 390px wide: 16px on 6 of 12 sites, 24px on 3.

gutter-md.$description: Page margin from hw-bp-md to hw-bp-lg.

gutter-lg.$description: Page margin at hw-bp-lg and above.

column-gap.$description: The gutter between grid columns. 24px is the fourth most used column-gap in the capture (93 uses) and the largest that stays on the 4px grid at every step.

columns.$description: Twelve columns above hw-bp-lg, six from hw-bp-md, four below. 58 of the grids sampled use twelve.

container-app.$description: The app shell's cap. Past it the content pane stops and the window grows around it.

container-page.$description: Marketing and documentation. The 1100-1300 band is the most occupied in the capture: 20 of 44 sites.

container-prose.$description: A reading column on its own. The median measured prose column at 1440px across the capture is 721px.

measure-prose.$description: Long-form. The median measured running-text width across 30 sites is 64ch; 68ch sits inside the comfortable band and above the product step.

rail.$description: The app shell's navigation rail at hw-bp-lg and above.

rail-collapsed.$description: The rail reduced to icons, which is the only collapsed state it has.

panel-w.$description: A menu-bar utility panel. 40ch of body-sm Public Sans measures 318.4px with the face loaded, plus hw-cell-pad-x each side, rounded up to the 4px grid.

panel-max-h.$description: A menu-bar panel's ceiling: a 32px header, 12 rows at hw-row-h-compact and a 48px footer. Always clamped further by min(, calc(100vh - hw-space-48)).

control-h-sm.$description: Compact control height: a toolbar button, an inline filter.

control-h.$description: The default control height. 32px is the most common measured button height in the capture, on 14 of 44 sites.

control-h-lg.$description: A single call to action on a marketing surface. Second most measured, on 11 sites.

row-h.$description: Comfortable table or list row: 13px text on 1.5 leading plus 12px above and below.

row-h-compact.$description: Compact row. The same text, 6px above and below, and nothing else changes.

cell-pad-x.$description: Horizontal cell padding, both densities. Density changes the vertical rhythm, never the column alignment.

cell-pad-y-compact.$description: Vertical padding in a table cell and a list row under data-density="compact". Horizontal padding does not change, which is what keeps a column in the same place across the toggle.

field-pad-x.$description: Horizontal padding inside a field, a select, a stepper and a search box. Unchanged by density, like hw-cell-pad-x, so a column of controls keeps its left edge across the toggle. Was an unnamed 10px literal in the Input anatomy, off the 4px grid.

icon-sm.$description: Inside a badge or beside 12px label text.

icon.$description: The default. 16x16 is the most widely used rendered icon size in the capture: 21 of 44 sites.

icon-lg.$description: A toolbar or rail icon that carries its own hit target.

icon-stroke.$description: Stroke weight at 16px and 20px. 1.5px on 8 sites, 2px on 12; 1.5px is the lighter of the two and the one that survives beside 13px text.

icon-gap.$description: Icon to its own label. Below the 4px grid on purpose: 4px reads as one object, 8px as two.

z-sticky.$description: A sticky table head or a pinned toolbar.

z-rail.$description: The app shell's rail when it overlays content below hw-bp-lg.

z-toast.$description: Toasts, which must clear a dialog because they report what the dialog did.

border-w.$description: Every border in the system. There is no 2px border.

focus-w.$description: The focus ring. 2px is the most used real outline-width in the capture: 246 declarations against 75 at 1px.

focus-offset.$description: The gap between the control's own edge and its ring, so the ring reads as a ring.

tab-active-w.$description: The rule under the selected tab, which is the one place a 2px line is a state.

display-1.$description: Page-defining headline on a marketing or release surface. One per page.
